findings.issue: GET /api/rights/dictionaries is unreachable due to two compounding defects. (a) Route conflict: the router uses first-match dispatch; registerRightsRoutes (line 160) registers GET /api/rights/:roleId BEFORE registerGrantsRoutes (line 166) registers GET /api/rights/dictionaries. Every request to /api/rights/dictionaries is captured by the param route with roleId='dictionaries' and returns 404 'role not found'. (b) DATABASE_URL gate: even if the conflict were fixed, registerGrantsRoutes is only called when grantsPool != null (line 165), so the dictionaries route — which is explicitly seed-backed and DB-free per ADR §2.1 — is silently unregistered in any dev environment without DATABASE_URL. Verified live: both with and without DATABASE_URL the endpoint returns 404. AC-16 FAILS.
findings.suggestion: Fix (a): move GET /api/rights/dictionaries registration into rights.ts (before the :roleId catch-all) or register it from grants.ts before registerRightsRoutes is called. Fix (b): extract the GET /api/rights/dictionaries handler out of the if(grantsPool) block — it needs no pool; register it unconditionally in server.ts alongside the other seed-backed rights routes.

findings.issue: NF-1 is violated: freeform scope is stored with delegable unchanged from the request body (defaults to true). Spec NF-1: 'Free-form scopes are accepted only if isGenesisOwner === true (and are forced delegable: false)'. The handler reads delegable = body.delegable ?? true at line 408 and inserts it verbatim — no override when isFreeform is true. A genesis owner can therefore persist a freeform grant row with delegable=true. Although validateNarrowing's Gate 2 (freeform parent => free_form_non_delegable) blocks runtime chaining, the data model invariant is broken and subsequent tools (T-0039, external readers) must not assume the DB enforces it.
findings.suggestion: Add: if (isFreeform) { delegable = false; } immediately after the delegable assignment at line 409, before building childGrant.

findings.issue: Double loadAdminContext call in POST /api/grants freeform path: line 373 calls loadAdminContext to check isGenesisOwner for freeform admission, then line 442 calls it again to build the admin context for validateAdminDelegation. This is wasteful (3 extra DB round-trips per genesis-owner freeform request) but not a correctness issue — both loads are from DB, so isGenesisOwner is DB-resolved both times.
findings.suggestion: Hoist the loadAdminContext call before the freeform check; reuse the result for both the freeform admission guard and the gate call.

findings.issue: withTenantTx does not call assertUuid on tenantId before string-interpolating it into SET LOCAL choros.tenant_id = '${tenantId}'. The org.ts withTenant helper calls assertUuid(tenantId, 'tenantId') as a defence-in-depth guard. Since tenantId in T-0030 comes from DEV_TENANT_ID (env var), the practical risk is low; but the inconsistency with the established pattern (T-0013 / T-0116 R-3) leaves the door open if the tenant-resolution seam changes.
findings.suggestion: Add assertUuidShape(tenantId, 'tenantId') at the top of withTenantTx, mirroring org.ts:84.

role_gap_evidence: SEED_ORACLE assessment: FAIL-CLOSED for unknown nodes. isDescendantOrSelfSeed(unknownId, ancestorId) returns false (ORG_SEED_CHILDREN[unknownId] ?? [] = []) — a grant scoped to a node not in the seed tree is not considered a descendant of any known admin scope, triggering scope_widens deny. Genesis owner bypasses the oracle entirely (step-3 short-circuit). No scope-extension hole.

isGenesisOwner DB-only resolution confirmed: loadAdminContext always queries role_assignment JOIN role WHERE slug='tenant-owner' AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND validity window. Sending isGenesisOwner:true or admin:{isGenesisOwner:true} in the request body has no effect — confirmed via adversarial probe (e-mironov + injected body field -> 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED no_admin_authority).
